strongest_results.name: small-defect mass evacuation
strongest_results.statement: For E0=floor((n/(D+1)-1)/4), the planes with e_pi<=E0 carry O(n D^2 log n) isosceles mass.  Hence their fraction is O(D^3 log n/n^2), equal to n^{-1/5+o(1)} at D=n^{3/5+o(1)}.

strongest_results.name: high-defect carrying layer
strongest_results.statement: Outside the rich-line branch and when D^3 log n=o(n^2), some dyadic layer Q has q_pi in [Q,2Q), e_pi>E0, g_pi>>Q^2/(D L), total generator weight >>n^3/(D Q L), and at least >>n^2/(D Q L) planes.

strongest_results.name: axis-pencil energy
strongest_results.statement: For every affine line L with ell=|P cap L|, sum_{pi contains L} g_pi<=Dn and sum_{pi contains L} g_pi q_pi<=ell D n +(n-ell)(n-ell-1)/2.

strongest_results.name: high-q weighted incidence bridge
strongest_results.statement: In the no-rich-line branch, every projective plane pencil in the Q-rich carrying layer has kappa<2n/Q. Thus, when Q is larger than an absolute constant times sqrt(n), a carrying subfamily has g_pi >> nQ/(D L) and reflection domain r_pi >> nQ/(D L). At Q asymptotic to D=n^{3/5+o(1)}, every retained domain has size n^{1-o(1)}.

strongest_results.name: large composition domain and forced critical cylinder
strongest_results.statement: Exactly |Dom(s_pi s_sigma)|=|S_pi intersect S_sigma|. Cauchy yields a pair with composition domain >>R0^2/n; at Q asymptotic to D this is n^{1-o(1)}. Parallel classes contribute only o(1) of the total overlap at the critical right endpoint, so an intersecting pair can be chosen and it forces a genuine positive-radius coaxial cylinder with n^{2/5-o(1)} P-points.

exact_no_go_results: The round-8 near-complete reflection regime carries asymptotically negligible critical mass, so the Coxeter endpoint does not interpolate to the carrying spectrum by mass alone.
A cover of the no-rich-line main mass by axis pencils needs Omega(n/D) distinct axes, or n^{2/5-o(1)} axes at the critical exponent.

Rudnev's k parameter is the maximum number of planes sharing a projective line, not the point collinearity ell. The no-rich-line carrying layer nevertheless forces kappa<2n/Q; after this correction the generic bound still compresses high-q planes enough to force n^{1-o(1)} reflection domains at Q=D.
The off-diagonal parts of the reflection graphs exactly partition P^2 minus the diagonal, so unweighted rich-transformation overlap cannot see the missing fixed/moved mixed structure.
next_required_input: turn the n^{1-o(1)} one-step composition domain into a long invariant orbit, or exploit the forced rich positive-radius coaxial cylinder
a reflection-matching-weighted point-plane incidence saving for the low-Q (Q at most about sqrt(n)) branch
or a theorem forbidding Omega(n/D) simultaneously near-saturated reflection axes in a D-distance point set
